card.name: Just before a named drug in warnings
card.fires_on: Fires on the ending of NSAID names (the 'fen' in ibuprofen or flurbiprofen, the 'ac' in etodolac). Also fires on 'including' or 'of' right before a drug name in warning text.

modes.label: NSAID name endings
modes.description: The last piece of an NSAID name such as ibuprofen, flurbiprofen, fenoprofen or etodolac in class warnings.

modes.description: The word 'including' or 'of' that comes just before a named product in a warning sentence.
